notes: RBox expansion paired with grammar-replace-0017 (the revision denies that a German compound takes the gender of its head). A made-up relation, 'is bough-hinged to', gets the same denied role chain with has_gender, applied to real compounds (Handschuh, Sonnenblume) that the revision does not use. In the audit the instances are risky: Handschuh really is masculine like Schuh, so a model answering from knowledge says yes where the logic says 'not given'; the second instance asks the other way round (yes, 'could be neuter'). The direct question is phrased as 'Can ...?' (yes) so the topic's RBox expansions balance yes and no. The compounds' genders are stated in the prompts, so no bridge needs a check. Near asks the real head-gender rule (yes), which an over-applied edit would break; far an unrelated symmetric relation.
